Name: Ra's Seasonal Haley
Author: ralmuce
Description:
I wanted to try my hand at pixel art, so I made new outfits and hair for Haley :D

Includes portraits and sprites for all seasons + beach, Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve

[b][size=4]Installation:[/size][/b]

1) Make sure you have Content Patcher installed
2) Unzip and drop into Mods folder
3) If you are using another portrait mod (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal Outfits[/url]), turn off their Haley variant in config, otherwise my mod won't show up
4) If you want the sprites to have a nose, you can enable it in the config

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]

Should be compatible with everything but mods that add additional portraits/sprites for Haley. 
If you catch a bug (or a stray pixel), let me know
